寿宴过后没两天，林国强去了趟地里。

五亩水浇地，绿油油一片。

萝卜苗拱出了土，白菜叶子舒展开，豆角秧顺着架子往上爬，黄瓜顶上还挂着黄花儿。

张老四蹲在地头抽旱烟，看见林国强过来，站起来拍拍屁股。

“林老板，你瞅瞅这菜，长得多好。”

林国强蹲下看了看，萝卜苗间距均匀，垄沟里没杂草，土是湿的，刚浇过。

“老四，你跟麻子干得不赖。”

张老四咧嘴笑：“你给工钱痛快，俺们干活也痛快。

对了，头茬小白菜差不多能吃了，要不要给你送店里去？”

“过几天吧，再长长。”

林国强站起来，拍了拍手上的土，“以后店里用的菜，先从这地里出。

用不完的，拉集市上卖。”

张老四应了一声，又想起什么：“林老板，你那饭店现在用菜量大不大？”

“不小。”

“那这五亩地怕是不够。”

林国强点点头。

他早算过了，五亩地，就算精心伺候，出的菜也只够饭店三四成的用量。

但这是一个开始，以后可以再包几亩地，或者直接跟周边菜农签合同。

自己手里有地，心里就不慌。

从地里回来，林国强蹬着三轮车路过镇东头，看见一间门面房前围了几个人。

林国伟和周桂芳正指挥着两个工人往里面搬东西，货架、柜台、木格子，地上还堆着几麻袋货。

看见林国强，林国伟脸上闪过一丝不自然。

“大哥，这是干啥呢？”林国强停下车。

周桂芳抢着答了，嗓门老大：“开杂货铺！你大哥在采石场干了那么多年，累死累活一个月才二十几块钱。

看你在镇上开店挣了钱，我们也琢磨着做点小买卖。”

林国强看了一眼那间门面。

位置偏，门头窄，以前是家修鞋的铺子。

林国伟从采石场辞了工，凑钱开了这家杂货铺。

准备卖些烟酒糖茶、油盐酱醋、针头线脑。

“挺好的。”林国强蹬上车走了。

当天晚上，林国伟就来了。

站在国强饭店门口，表情有些不自在。

赵素梅让他进来坐，他摆了摆手，说找老二说两句话。

林国强从后厨出来，擦了擦手。

林国伟把他拉到门口，压低声音：“老二，哥想跟你借点钱。”

“借多少？”

“二百。”

林国强看着他，没说话。

林国伟被他看得发毛，解释道：“杂货铺开起来了，但进货的钱不够。

你嫂子把家底都掏了，还找她娘家借了点，还差二百。

Not two days after the birthday party, Lin Guoqiang went to the fields.

Five acres of irrigated land are lush green.

The radish seedlings dug out of the soil, the cabbage leaves spread out, the bean seedlings climbed up the shelf, and the yellow flowers hung on the tops of the cucumbers.

Zhang Laosi was squatting on the ground smoking a dry cigarette. When he saw Lin Guoqiang coming over, he stood up and patted his butt.

"Boss Lin, look at this dish, how good it looks."

Lin Guoqiang knelt down and took a look. The radish seedlings were evenly spaced, there were no weeds in the furrows, and the soil was wet and had just been watered.

"Fourth, you and Mazi did a good job."

Zhang Laosi grinned: "You pay me happily, and we work happily.

By the way, the first crop of Chinese cabbage is almost ready to eat. Do you want to send it to the store for you?"

"In a few days, it will grow longer."

Lin Guoqiang stood up and patted the dirt on his hands, "From now on, the vegetables used in the store will come from this land first.

If you can't use it up, sell it in the market."

Zhang Laosi responded and then thought of something: "Boss Lin, is your restaurant using a lot of food now?"

"Not small."

"Then I'm afraid these five acres of land won't be enough."

Lin Guoqiang nodded.

He had already calculated that with five acres of land, even if he took care of it carefully, the food produced would only be enough for 30 to 40% of the restaurant's consumption.

But this is a start. In the future, we can lease a few more acres of land, or directly sign contracts with surrounding vegetable farmers.

If you have land in your hands, you won't panic.

After returning from the fields, Lin Guoqiang passed by the east end of the town on his tricycle and saw a few people gathered in front of a front house.

Lin Guowei and Zhou Guifang were directing two workers to move things inside, including shelves, counters, wooden grids, and several sacks of goods piled on the ground.

Seeing Lin Guoqiang, a trace of uneasiness flashed across Lin Guowei's face.

"Brother, what are you doing?" Lin Guoqiang stopped the car.

Zhou Guifang rushed to answer, with a loud voice: "Open a grocery store! Your eldest brother has worked in the quarry for so many years, and he only earns twenty yuan a month after working exhaustingly.

Seeing that you have made money by opening a store in the town, we are also thinking about doing some small business."

Lin Guoqiang glanced at the facade.

The location is remote and the front door is narrow. It used to be a shoe repair shop.

Lin Guowei quit his job in the quarry and scraped together money to open this grocery store.

I am going to sell some tobacco, wine, sugar, tea, oil, salt, sauce, vinegar, needles, thread, and brains.

"Very good." Lin Guoqiang got in the car and drove away.

That night, Lin Guowei came.

Standing at the door of Guoqiang Hotel, he looked a little uncomfortable.

Zhao Sumei asked him to come in and sit down. He waved his hand and said he wanted to talk to his second son.

Lin Guoqiang came out of the kitchen and wiped his hands.

Lin Guowei pulled him to the door and lowered his voice: "Second brother, I want to borrow some money from you."

"How much to borrow?"

"Two hundred."

Lin Guoqiang looked at him and said nothing.

Lin Guowei was shocked by what he saw and explained: "The grocery store is open, but there is not enough money to purchase the goods.

Your sister-in-law emptied all the money from her family and even borrowed some money from her parents' family, which is still two hundred short.
